title: moringa pterygosperma
intro: Moringa pterygosperma, commonly known as Ben Oil Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Moringaceae. This plant is valued for its seeds, which are rich in oil and contain numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Moringa pterygosperma include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Moringa pterygosperma include fatty acids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
